title: Repeated nonadaptive tester
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester from a domain to a codomain with $r$ query positions, and let $k$ be a natural number. The repeated tester has $kr$ query positions; its random seed consists of $k$ independently sampled seeds of $T$, and it uses the corresponding copy of $T$'s query at each block position, accepting according to the repeated transcript rule.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive tester $T$ with $r$ query positions
caveat: The independent product distribution and repeated-transcript acceptance rule are referenced by auxiliary definitions not supplied here.
